WITH baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) as baseline_avg
  FROM Order_Items
  WHERE product_quantity IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  oi.order_id,
  AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS REAL)) as order_avg_quantity,
  AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS REAL)) - baseline.baseline_avg as difference
FROM Order_Items oi, baseline
WHERE baseline.baseline_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND oi.product_quantity IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY oi.order_id, baseline.baseline_avg
ORDER BY CASE WHEN difference IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, difference DESC
LIMIT 10
